name: Outlines
summary: Structured LLM output library from .txt (dottxt): JSON/schema/grammar constraints with broad model integrations.
description: Established Apache-2.0 structured-generation library (dottxt-ai/outlines; not archived). PyPI outlines 1.3.3 verified 2026-11-09. Docs at https://dottxt-ai.github.io/outlines/. Optional commercial/enterprise offerings from .txt are separate from the open-source package. Model inference costs are not included.
